verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev provides a documented CLI for local dev, self-hosting, and deploy, GitHub Actions integration for CI-triggered deploys, a management SDK/API for programmatic run triggering and status checks, and headless runtime probes confirm the CLI installs keylessly via npx and the management API is live and auth-gated — all consistent with headless/CI automation. missing for 10: independent community reports specifically confirming CI/headless automation workflows (evidence is mostly first-party docs plus generic satisfaction quotes, not CI-specific hands-on accounts).
